CustomObject.description: Per-user/profile configuration for FlipSwitch. Override logging and flag behavior per user or profile.

fields.description: How evaluation logs are saved. EVENT_BUS = Platform Event (default), QUEUEABLE = async job, SYNCHRONOUS = direct DML (debug only).
fields.label: Default Save Method

fields.description: Set to false to disable evaluation logging for this user/profile. Useful for high-volume service users.
fields.label: Is Logging Enabled

fields.description: QA/testing override. Enable_All forces all flags on; Disable_All forces all flags off. Use None for normal evaluation.
fields.label: Override All Flags

CustomObject.label: Feature Flag Settings
